purpose: Real-video baseline reproduction and clean continuous subwindow comparison
selection: Next two subject IDs after previously processed subjects; fixed before inspecting their signals or labels
continuous_selection: Longest contiguous section shared by at least two usable parent regions; ties favor more usable regions then earliest start; never consult pulse estimates or references
reference: Stored device BPM on the exact analyzed support; retain existing band/gap validity checks and assumed elapsed-time offset zero
failure_policy: Do not substitute failed downloads or inference; do not adjust thresholds after fresh outcomes; keep the full-window policy as default
